newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa sees earnings growth higher than 1996.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa sees earnings growth higher than 1996.

text.p: German airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG said on Wednesday in a regulatory statement that its earnings growth would be higher in the current year than in 1996.
The company said that profit in 1996 was estimated at about 700 million marks and in 1995 it earned 756 million marks in ordinary operations.
Business developments were affected by the difficult economic conditions and stiff competition, it said.

Lufthansa is due to announce its annual results for 1996 on May 7. It issued the regulatory statement in response to an unpublished report in Germany's Capital business magazine which is due for publication on Friday.
